scripts.dev:all: docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/dev/container/.env -f deployment/v1/dev/container/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/dev/field/.env -f deployment/v1/dev/field/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/dev/boss/.env -f deployment/v1/dev/boss/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.dev:all-down: docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/dev/container/.env -f deployment/v1/dev/container/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/dev/field/.env -f deployment/v1/dev/field/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/dev/boss/.env -f deployment/v1/dev/boss/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.register:demo-integration: tools/register-container.sh --env deployment/v2/dev/field/.env --container-env deployment/v2/dev/container/.env,deployment/v2/dev/container2/.env --url http://localhost:5002 --container container-1,container-2 --station bess1,bess2 --token-var CONTAINER_TOKEN,CONTAINER2_TOKEN
scripts.register:aws-demo: tools/register-container.sh --env deployment/v2/aws/.env --container-env deployment/v2/aws/.env --url http://localhost:88 --container container-1,container-2 --station bess1,bess2 --token-var C1_CONTAINER_TOKEN,C2_CONTAINER_TOKEN
scripts.start:aws-edge: docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/aws/container/.env -f deployment/v1/aws/container/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/aws/field/.env -f deployment/v1/aws/field/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.stop:aws-edge: docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/aws/field/.env -f deployment/v1/aws/field/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose --env-file deployment/v1/aws/container/.env -f deployment/v1/aws/container/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.start:aws-demo-edge: docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/aws/container/.env -f deployment/v2/aws/container/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/aws/field/.env -f deployment/v2/aws/field/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.stop:aws-demo-edge: docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/aws/field/.env -f deployment/v2/aws/field/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/aws/container/.env -f deployment/v2/aws/container/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.start:demo-integration: docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/dev/container/.env -f deployment/v2/dev/container/docker-compose.yml up -d --build --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/dev/container2/.env -f deployment/v2/dev/container2/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/dev/field/.env -f deployment/v2/dev/field/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.stop:demo-integration: docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/dev/field/.env -f deployment/v2/dev/field/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/dev/container2/.env -f deployment/v2/dev/container2/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose --env-file deployment/v2/dev/container/.env -f deployment/v2/dev/container/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans
